newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Howard says Australian economy pickup evident.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Howard says Australian economy pickup evident.

text.p: Australian Prime Minister John Howard on Thursday said a pickup in the Australian economy was now evident.

"The pickup in the economy which is now evident -- investment figures, lower interest rates, greater starts -- that will ultimately feed through into the labour market and I believe that next year we will have a much stronger employment figure," Howard told Australian Broadcasting Corp television.
